Each tutorial is a set of chapters with definitions, theorems, worked examples and exercises with solutions. The
tutorials form tracks, each read from left to right.

## Physics {#track-physics}

The mathematics for physicists, then theoretical physics, then Kaluza-Klein theories.

::: {#physics}
:::

## Machine learning {#track-machine-learning}

The mathematics for machine learning, read alongside machine learning.

::: {#machine-learning}
:::

## Complexity science {#track-complexity-science}

Complexity science, which draws on the mathematics for physicists and on statistical physics.

::: {#complexity-science}
:::

## Computer science {#track-computer-science}

System design, which draws on the probability of the mathematics for physicists and on complexity science.

::: {#computer-science}
:::
